notes.title: Lost Words chosen as IGF Finalist
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33701944/c222bdb8d6d086f2550f8460e163ffe06ce468c8.jpg[/img]

We have some very exciting news! ːp2cubeː

The Game Developers Conference has just revealed the finalists for the 23rd annual awards ceremony of the Independent Games Festival (IGF), the longest running festival, summit and showcase celebrating independent games and their creators.

[b]We are honoured to be able to announce that Lost Words has been nominated for the IGF award for Excellence in Narrative. [/b]

Other IGF nominees this year include the excellent Paradise Killer by our friends at Kaizen Game Works and the amazing Spiritfarer by Thunder Lotus.

The IGF is part of GDC 2021, which will take place as a virtual event from July 19 through July 23. 

There will be an audience choice vote too so keep an eye out for that!

[url=https://igf.com/article/genesis-noir-leads-igf-finalists-four-nominations]https://igf.com/article/genesis-noir-leads-igf-finalists-four-nominations[/url]

notes.title: Check out the Brand New Accolades Trailer for Lost Words: Beyond the Page
notes.content:
Lost Words: Beyond the Page released earlier this month and has since received both critic and fan praise for its visuals, heartfelt story, amazing music, and more. To celebrate, we have put some of those kind words in a brand-new Accolades trailer. Check it out here: 

https://youtu.be/7_jcebhAOx0

Lost Words: Beyond the Page is an atmospheric narrative adventure revolving around the touching story of a young girl named Izzy coming to terms with life’s hardships by creating the journey of a lifetime within the pages of her diary. From right out of the gate, the game caught the attention of critics across the industry. Check out some of the quotes from reviews about the game below.  

[list]
[*] Geek Tyrant - "Synergizes gameplay and story better than anything I've played in a long time." 
[*] Gameffine - "Flawlessly embodies how words can shape worlds." 
[*] Gaming Trend -  "A heartfelt and human exploration of grief. 
[*] M2Gaming - "For the first time we felt like one word was worth a thousand images and not the opposite!" 
[*] Mega Dads - "The game is beautiful on the eyes. The art style defines what it means for a game to be considered art. It's a watercolor painting come to life."  
[*] Metro Media - “An amazing masterpiece that will blow your mind with its brightful color and design and its incredible narrative.” 
[*] Nintendo Link - "A masterpiece. 
[*] Overclockers Club - "Truly well done." 
[*] TechRaptor -  "Lost Words is a heartfelt tale bound in the pages of a story, but its themes of family and kindness go beyond fiction." 
[/list]

Penned by renowned writer Rhianna Pratchett (Mirror’s Edge, Tomb Raider, Rise of the Tomb Raider), Lost Words: Beyond the Page is a captivating adventure wrapped in an overarching and undeniably touching narrative. The title has earned a wealth of awards during its lifetime, including ‘Best Indie Game’ at Game Connection Paris, ‘Excellence in Narrative’ at DevGAMM, ‘Best Audio Design’ from TIGA, ‘Special Selection Indie Award’ at Reboot Develop and ‘Best Story’ at Game Connection USA. 

Lost Words: Beyond the Page is available now.

notes.title: Lost Words IndieCade Nomination
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that Lost Words: Beyond the Page has been selected as a [url=https://www.gamasutra.com/view/news/370798/50_standout_indie_games_nominated_in_this_years_IndieCade_Awards.php]nominee for IndieCade Anywhere and Everywhere[/url]! 

IndieCade celebrates the innovation and future of independently developed games. There are around 17 different categories for the awards and Lost Words is in the running for the Grand Jury Award, Jury Prix, Innovation in Experience Design, Innovation in Interaction Design as well as Performance. 

The festival has been taking place virtually and the awards are being livestreamed today at 12 Noon PT / 19:00 GMT on IndieCade's Twitch channel here: https://www.twitch.tv/indiecade

notes.title: Thanks for Visiting Us At PAX!
notes.content:
Happy Hump Day everyone!

Our Modus Team had a great time over the past weekend at PAX West, because of YOU. Thank you for stopping by, saying hi, and for all the love you’ve given our upcoming games. We are so grateful for all the support for Lost Words, we couldn’t have done it without you. This year was truly a success being able to feature Lost Words on the show floor and we are just as excited as you are to share more exciting news for our titles. We loved seeing all your awesome faces this year!

Well there will be lots of other games, though the big companies will shout the loudest. That doesn’t seem fair as even smaller games deserve some time in the spotlight, because with enough eyes, they could rise to prominence. Then there’s those that have been rumoured, but may not appear. With over 50 games already confirmed to be at the show, we thought we’d put together an alphabetical list of games that have been confirmed to appear at this year’s E3 show.
